d:
The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) returned to the streets with its first major protest after the recent peace bond controversy.
The protest was held in Kochi against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke and actor Prakash Raj joined the demonstration at Rajendra Maidan.
Protesters demanded the withdrawal of SIR and resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
The Kochi protest marks a fresh phase in CJP’s campaign against the Election Commission’s voter-list revision exercise.
